options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: check
options.description: The name of the check the entry should match. If left empty a silencing entry will contain an asterisk in the check position.

options.name: namespace
options.description: RBAC namespace to operate in. If this is not set the value of the SENSU_NAMESPACE environment variable will be used.

options.name: subscription
options.description: The name of the subscription the entry should match. If left empty a silencing entry will contain an asterisk in the subscription position.
